RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

The panel’s composition alone is not evidence of bias. Healthcare leadership and HR roles frequently have female-majority panels simply due to organizational demographics. 

For the head of a clinical laboratory, operational management and executive leadership are often prioritized over academic credentials like a PhD; the chosen candidate possessed formal management training and broad leadership experience. 

Accusing the panel of sex discrimination without concrete evidence—such as discriminatory remarks or documented procedural irregularities—is legally unviable and will severely damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on specific leadership competencies to help position yourself for future director-level opportunities.
